scope: 2024 ICPC Chengdu A B G I J L
limitations: Small-case checks only; no online submissions or maximum-size runtime tests.

A.method: full painting-state reachability through n8 and actual construction replay for every binary target through n12

B.method: rolling count/last DP and actual three-axis prefix sums versus every question-mark filling and every capacity triple on random strings

G.method: replay all adjacent insertions producing the eight candidates and compare with unrestricted algebra closure for endpoints0..31

I.method: actual gcd segment-tree point updates versus explicitly checking every block size after each random modification

J.method: timestamp stream processing versus independent per-level log extraction, first valid event selection, and finish ranking

L.method: generated datasets independently counted at all three threshold values and checked against output bounds
